newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee futures called to open flat to up 0.50.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee futures called to open flat to up 0.50.

text.p: CSCE arabica coffee futures were called to open unchanged to 0.50 cent higher Wednesday as traders expect the market's recent upswing to continue.

New York coffee futures ended up Tuesday but below new contract highs hit early in the day after a bout of commission house profit taking. March delivery rose 1.80 cents to 147.45 cents a lb after ranging from 150.50 to 145.75. Second-month May finished up 1.95 cents at 142.55 cents, while the outer months gained 1.50 to 2.70.
Technically, traders said the March contract would face resistance at 149.00, then 151.00, just above its life-of-contract high of 150.50. Near-term support was seen at 145.50, followed by 142.15.

London robusta coffee futures eased in thin trade early Wednesday. March delivery fell $14 at the midday break, to $1,544 a tonne, while May was off $3, to $1,555. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk 212 859 1640))
